title.narrative: Programme coordination remained challenging in the reporting year given the evolving nature of UNICEF’s programming and partnerships in response to the current economic crisis context. UNICEF has remained agile and responsive in its work, prioritising the COVID-19 and economic crisis response in coordination with the UN Resident Coordinator Office and UN agencies as required. The new Country Programme Document 2023-2027 has been endorsed by the Government of Sri Lanka and approved by UNICEF’s Executive Board, providing the strategic direction over the next five years in close alignment with the UN Sustainable Development Cooperation Framework 2023-2027.
